note: Fitness (Dave 2026-10-21): a character attribute, a whole number min to max (-10 to +10), 0 an average adult, that directly sets how fast exertion rises during strenuous activity (running, climbing, tool work, heavy loads): the rise per second is multiplied by exp(-fitness x strength), so +10 fitness at strength 0.05 raises exertion at about 61 percent of the normal pace (winded after about 1.65 times as long) and -10 at about 165 percent. Falling (recovery) is not touched. It is stored with the character in characters.json like luck. New characters start at default. Training (Dave 2026-10-21: starts fixed, trains slowly): the creation value is the base; any physical effort trains it like a skill (Dave 2 Nov 2026): effort at or above min_effort (0.5: walking, jogging, running, tool work, loads) earns XP at base_share (0.25) of the running rate, rising to 1 at full effort; staying above the line for streak_bonus_s earns up to streak_bonus_max extra; every point costs the same seconds_per_point of full-effort time (level_growth 0; Dave 4 Nov: it also declines and any activity helps, so it does not get harder; raise level_growth for a rising cost); up to max_gain above the base. Effort under the line neither earns nor costs. Only effort under rest_effort (0.02) for more than rest_grace_s loses one point per decay_s_per_point (12 h), never below the base (Dave 4 Nov, BUG-023). set_fitness() sets the base and clears the training. Set strength to 0 to switch fitness off.
